criteria.statement: Default instances enforce lifecycle, explicit capabilities, zero-default daily/monthly USD budgets, reserve-then-settle usage and visible gating.
Connections and network access remain owner-authorized, credential-isolated and allow-list controlled.
Landing, magic-link authentication and wizard create a tenant-isolated Default instance through canonical validation.
Built-in chat uses the same creation service and cannot bypass controls or receive credentials.
Owner pages truthfully show instances, controls, usage, gating and redacted audit history with cross-surface equivalence.
